page.layout: One block of centred title lines at the top of the page; below them a woodcut ornament; then the printer's imprint and date at the foot. No margins with text.
page.notes: A woodcut ornament (a cherub's head between foliage and drapery swags) stands between the "Additus est" lines and the imprint; it is not text. The title line "ÎN HISTORIAM" has its initial I with an accent-like stroke as printed. The lines "Homiliæ Theodori Bezæ" and "Gallicis latinæ factæ" are in italic script. The date reads M. D. XCII (1592).
